answer_1.quote: MARS, a multimodal conversational agent capable of understanding and generating nonverbal cues alongside textual context in dialogues.
answer_1.outputs: Generated text interleaved with discrete nonverbal tokens representing facial expressions and body movements

answer_2.quote: We use Perplexity (PPL) as a general measure for both text and nonverbal tokens. For text tokens, we use BERT-score and METEOR as evaluation metrics, while for nonverbal tokens, we rely on Negative log-likelihood (NLL). ... We also evaluate realism and diversity of motions using VMSE, LVD, Window Vertex L2, Diversity, and Variance.

answer_4.quote: supported by user studies, quantitative evaluations, and qualitative analyses. ... Qualitative Results. We use qualitative results to assess the effectiveness of our model in generating the listener's text and nonverbal expressions.
